_comment: lab.json — AUTHORED judgment facts about the lab that are NOT derivable from collected inventory and must not be baked into code (ADR 0003: authored data with a deterministic consumer lives in data, not in a bash `case`). Read by the entity helper (scripts/entity.sh), the audit (scripts/audit-entities.sh), and the renderer (scripts/render-docs.sh). Everything here is topology/display judgment; hard-law constraints live in invariants.json (which also holds the VMID<->IP law + declared entity exceptions in entity_conventions). Grammar: docs/conventions/naming.md.

vlans._comment: VLAN display names + the short slugs used in entity IDs (guest/<role>-<slug>-<vmid>). Wording follows the OPNsense alias descriptions in the firewall mirror — collected truth, not a guess. Moved out of render-docs.sh's vlan_name() case in SKY-018 P2. Do NOT swap 10 and 60: 10 is the trusted client VLAN, 60 is admin access (the Management Caddy front door). VLAN 40 exists in firewall nets but hosts no guest and has no slug.

front_doors._comment: The reverse-proxy front-door alias set — this is what makes a name a VHOST, not a host. A DNS record whose target is one of these IPs resolves to a proxy that fans out to many backends, so it must render as 'front door - not the host' (SKY-015 / SKY-018 P3), never as a machine. Declared here explicitly instead of inferred from 'IP shared by >1 DNS name', so a single-vhost front door is still recognised.

aliases.why: the apps Caddy on the DMZ macvlan; *.aliammar.net app vhosts (karakeep, obsidian, calibre, ...) resolve here.
the Management Caddy (T3); admin vhosts (arcane, pbs, proxmox-*, unraid, omada, ...) A-record here.

docker_hosts._comment: Maps a docker inventory `host` label (inventory/docker-<label>.json) to the guest VMID it runs on, so `service --hosted_on--> guest` is a data lookup, not a `vm-`-prefix string-munge. A second docker host is a new row here, not a code change.

hosts.label: docker-dmz
hosts.why: the DMZ docker host (VLAN 100, 10.10.100.15); every compose project in inventory/docker-docker-dmz.json is hosted_on this guest.
